lines.trans: Is Mr Chun Yu in his office?
He's inside, alright — if you aren't afraid of dying, go right on in.
Since when have I ever been afraid of dying?
Get out!
Mr Chun Yu, do you know where Zhong Yangzi is? I searched all night long and found zero trace of her online.
From what I learned, her contract with Baishi has no legal validity — yet unless she steps forward to claim her rights, our hands are tied.
